item.title: When do you start saying Merry Christmas in Sweden?
item.description: There are a surprising number of unwritten rules when it comes to greeting people throughout the Christmas season. So when should you say god jul, and when is it better to wish someone a 'good continuation' or a 'good end' instead?

item.title: Workers dismissed from Sweden's Northvolt to get EU aid
item.description: The EU has voted to compensate the more than 5,000 people who lost their jobs when the Swedish electric battery producer Northvolt went bankrupt in March.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Wednesday
item.description: Former Northvolt workers to get EU aid, fixed-term mortgage rates starting to rise and labour market sees slow recovery. Here's Sweden's news on Wednesday.

item.title: UK set to rejoin EU's Erasmus scheme from 2027
item.description: Britain is set to rejoin the European Union's Erasmus student exchange programme, which it left almost five years ago following Brexit, UK media reported late Tuesday.

item.title: Sweden in 2026: Will immigration be a big election issue?
item.description: In this week’s episode of Sweden in Focus Extra, we hear from Jonas Hinnfors, one of Sweden's leading political commentators.

item.title: Courts in Sweden criticise proposal to revoke permanent residency permits
item.description: Four of Sweden's highest legal authorities have advised the government to drop a proposal to revoke permanent residency permits, warning that it risks massive costs, would overwhelm the legal system, and threatens important legal principles.

item.title: 'Not going to wait': Sweden's parties discuss gang crime
item.description: Swedish Justice Minister Gunnar Strömmer called the country's parliamentary parties to a joint meeting to discuss measures to fight gang crime on Wednesday, after the opposition Social Democrats called for the Moderates to join them in a ten-year pact to end the problem.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: polkagris
item.description: Today's word describes a festive sweet treat with surprising Swedish origins.

item.title: 19 European countries call on EU to fund migrant 'return hubs'
item.description: After the European Union significantly tightened its immigration policy earlier this month, 19 EU countries on Wednesday urged the European Commission to finance "return hubs" outside the bloc for failed asylum-seekers.

item.title: What will happen in Swedish politics in election year 2026?
item.description: Everything in Swedish politics next year will point towards the election on September 13th. We spoke to three Swedish university professors to get their predictions on how it will play out.
